description: Journal pages, May 8, 1938 and May 16, 1938, written in Villeneuvre-les-Avignon, but the entries concern Maria Chabot's family relationships found with a poem concrete, "Fisches Nachtgesang" [Fishes's Night Hymn], no author or date. Newspaper clipping concerning Maria Chabot's return to San Antonio with Dorothy Stewart.
title: Two journal pages, poem, and clipping
